scope: Frozen source; all public operation families and private state/helper families in the two data files

entries.name: module boundary, exported imports and opaque implementation declarations
entries.purpose: Expose named-module data API and hide implementation state
entries.costs: Three exported core partitions; standard headers affect BMI; no public implementation dependency

entries.name: all_t, all, indices, range, mask, labels
entries.purpose: Specify Python-like axis selectors with owned inputs
entries.costs: vectors own selector material; labels initializer copies strings; ranges are compact

entries.name: Selection and Selection::Kind
entries.purpose: Resolve selection forms into an Axis
entries.costs: All alternative fields are held simultaneously; scalar index allocates; public layout influences BMI

entries.name: Selection integral constructors
entries.purpose: Accept integral positions and reject values outside signed range
entries.costs: Template executes once per construction; uses signed and unsigned width checks

entries.name: Selection label constructors, state observers and resolve overloads
entries.purpose: Expose selector state and resolve against axis names
entries.costs: char pointer has unchecked null precondition; observers expose STL representations; resolution may scan or allocate

entries.name: ColumnKind, StringMissingValue
entries.purpose: Identify column storage and nullable string sentinel
entries.costs: Small enums preserve semantic distinctions

entries.name: ColumnView lifecycle and size/kind/nullable/valid
entries.purpose: Retain read-only column binding and inspect rows
entries.costs: shared ownership; categorical valid resolves row twice; accesses bounds check

entries.name: ColumnView values/string/string_missing_value
entries.purpose: Read numeric buffers and packed strings with explicit missing convention
entries.costs: values can create selected descriptor; string_view borrows retained column bytes

entries.name: ColumnView ordered/categories/code/codes
entries.purpose: Expose categorical dictionary and code access
entries.costs: categories allocates descriptor; code checks and dispatches; codes can validate, allocate and recode

entries.name: ColumnView copy/select/select_all
entries.purpose: Deep-copy selected values or compose selected rows and prune dictionary
entries.costs: selection can scan codes and allocate maps; copy can stage and copy

entries.name: Column move-only lifetime and numeric factories
entries.purpose: Own numeric columns with nullable validity
entries.costs: shared private state retains views; factories validate shape and validity

entries.name: Column string and nullable string overloads
entries.purpose: Build owned packed UTF-8 and preserve nullable sentinel
entries.costs: initializer-list overload stages strings then packs; vectors grow while packing

entries.name: Column packed-string trusted/full factories
entries.purpose: Adopt byte/offset/validity buffers with optional validation
entries.costs: moves three vectors; full validates UTF-8 and offsets; none trusts caller

entries.name: Column categorical/from_values factories
entries.purpose: Construct typed codes and categories or numeric initializer data
entries.costs: full category validation scans and hashes; template fills array directly

entries.name: Column view/copy/size/kind/edit_values/unsafe_edit_codes/set_valid/validate
entries.purpose: Acquire retained views or controlled edits, mutate validity, explicitly validate
entries.costs: edits alias retained data; validity allocates on first write; categorical validation scans

entries.name: TableView lifecycle, size/index/name/name lists
entries.purpose: Inspect retained row index and enumerate bindings
entries.costs: names and column_names copy strings; name returns borrowed view

entries.name: TableView contains/column/select/select_all/copy
entries.purpose: Find retained columns, select rows and explicitly deep copy
entries.costs: linear lookup; selections copy column binding descriptors and may prune

entries.name: Table lifecycle, index constructors, numbered and size
entries.purpose: Own a table and build explicit axis names
entries.costs: with_index constructs then replaces empty name storage; numbered materializes strings

entries.name: Table view/copy/set/erase/column/edit_values/set_names/validate
entries.purpose: Retain or mutate table and maintain row counts
entries.costs: view snapshots all columns; direct column avoids unrelated snapshots; mutation requires caller synchronization

entries.name: ElementKind and Element owner constructors/mapping/scalar
entries.purpose: Represent heterogeneous metadata and recursively owned mappings
entries.costs: heap-allocated implementation holds alternatives simultaneously; scalar widths preserved

entries.name: Element view/copy/set/byte-order/erase/at/validate
entries.purpose: Manage metadata mappings and explicit serialization metadata
entries.costs: linear key lookup; recursive validate/copy; views retain shared bindings

entries.name: ElementView kind/dtype/scalar/scalar accessors
entries.purpose: Inspect typed metadata scalars with dtype and width
entries.costs: dtype and kind checks; numeric data held in widened scalar fields

entries.name: ElementView string/byte order/array/string_array/record_array/column/table
entries.purpose: Borrow strings and acquire typed retained payload views
entries.costs: runtime kind check; column/table owner conversion may allocate descriptors

entries.name: ElementView keys/contains/at/copy
entries.purpose: Inspect and deep-copy metadata mappings
entries.costs: linear lookup; keys allocate/copy; copy recursively constructs entries

entries.name: AnnData lifecycle/empty/dimensions/X and edits
entries.purpose: Own aligned observation-variable dataset and optional matrix
entries.costs: numbered default axes allocate labels; dimensions checked before replacement

entries.name: AnnData obs/var and column/edit operations
entries.purpose: Manage axis tables and their numerical columns
entries.costs: obs/var build snapshots; direct column lookup avoids full snapshot; replacements rebind aligned table indices

entries.name: AnnData aligned and pairwise setters, accessors, edits and names
entries.purpose: Own X-aligned, axis-aligned and pairwise annotations
entries.costs: shape/index checks; vector linear lookup; names copied; Array edits borrow storage

entries.name: AnnData uns and raw operations
entries.purpose: Manage unstructured metadata and raw variables/X/varm
entries.costs: mapping and alignment validation; raw X optional and obs-aligned

entries.name: AnnData view/slice/copy/validate
entries.purpose: Capture a retained snapshot, select axes, deep-copy and check invariants
entries.costs: view eagerly snapshots descriptors; slice handles categories and color metadata; copy materializes

entries.name: AnnDataView dimensions/X/axis/slot operations
entries.purpose: Access retained snapshot of aligned data
entries.costs: lookup linear, names allocated; underlying mutable payload may remain shared

entries.name: AnnDataView uns/raw/slice/copy
entries.purpose: Access raw and unstructured state, compose selections and copy
entries.costs: slice allocates descriptors/maps and prunes category colors; copy allocates payloads

entries.name: ColumnImpl state and size
entries.purpose: Store values or packed strings, validity and categorical dictionary
entries.costs: inactive state retained in every kind; shared state permits retained views

entries.name: ColumnViewImpl source/rows/pruning state and row
entries.purpose: Keep retained source, row map and category recoding
entries.costs: two vectors in every view and deep-copied when descriptor copied

entries.name: TableImpl and TableViewImpl
entries.purpose: Own names and ordered columns; snapshot binding set and row map
entries.costs: shared names retain index; copied strings and column-view descriptors for snapshot

entries.name: ElementImpl scalar, owner, view and mapping state
entries.purpose: Keep heterogeneous metadata with owned or selected payload
entries.costs: all alternatives have inline storage even when inactive; shared allocation per element

entries.name: RawData, AnnDataImpl and AnnDataViewImpl
entries.purpose: Represent aligned slots, raw data and captured absolute view maps
entries.costs: ordered vectors permit linear lookups; view retains source plus derived bindings

entries.name: fail and validate_at
entries.purpose: Propagate error code/path across nested validation
entries.costs: exception construction copies path only on failure

entries.name: find_key, require_key, put, keys and same_index
entries.purpose: Manage ordered named slots and compare indexes directly
entries.costs: linear search, insertion order; keys copies; same_index traverses without materialization

entries.name: visit_numeric, read_code, make_codes
entries.purpose: Dispatch supported dtypes, read unaligned integer codes and materialize recoded output
entries.costs: dtype switch per read_code; memcpy portable for alignment; make_codes copies input then overwrites

entries.name: compose_rows
entries.purpose: Compose selections with row-specific error context
entries.costs: delegates to Axis implementation; exceptions remapped

entries.name: valid_utf8_string and validate_packed_strings
entries.purpose: Check UTF-8 and monotonic complete packed offsets
entries.costs: full scan in validation; trusted factory may defer it

entries.name: check_validity and check_category_dictionary
entries.purpose: Check mask entries, no missing or duplicate categories, and reject NaN
entries.costs: linear validity scan; per-kind hash sets allocate and scan categories

entries.name: check_kind/check_matrix/check_first/check_pairwise
entries.purpose: Enforce element kind and AnnData alignment at boundaries
entries.costs: constant checks; rank/shape contracts documented by error messages

entries.name: select_first/select_both overloads
entries.purpose: Apply aligned row and pairwise axes while retaining untouched dimensions
entries.costs: allocates rank-sized Axis vector for non-all selection; rank preconditions come from alignment checks

entries.name: Selection constructors and resolution
entries.purpose: Map signed positions, masks, ranges, labels to selected Axis
entries.costs: single labels scan; multi-label builds hash table; range remains compact stride

entries.name: Column constructors and numeric/string/packed/categorical factories
entries.purpose: Establish column representation and validation boundary
entries.costs: packed input can move; ordinary strings copy payload to packed vectors; category full validation scans

entries.name: Column::view and ColumnView accessors
entries.purpose: Acquire retained descriptor and read validity, value, categorical data
entries.costs: one descriptor allocation per view; validity duplicates categorical row resolution; categories builds gather

entries.name: ColumnView::codes, select and select_all
entries.purpose: Expose recoded codes and build category pruning plans
entries.costs: nonidentity recoding stages int64 values and copied typed array; pruning reads each code twice; descriptor maps copied

entries.name: ColumnView::copy, Column mutation and validation
entries.purpose: Materialize selected column, edit values or validate invariants
entries.costs: categorical recoding may copy twice; string copy stages individual allocations

entries.name: Table constructors and with_index/numbered
entries.purpose: Create explicit ordered row names
entries.costs: with_index creates and discards default empty names owner; numbered creates decimal strings

entries.name: Table view/copy/set/erase/column/edit/set_names/validate
entries.purpose: Manage table binding snapshots, direct column acquisition and invariants
entries.costs: view allocates/copies every binding; direct column avoids it; index replacement preserves prior snapshots

entries.name: TableView accessors/selection/copy/with_rows
entries.purpose: Access retained names and column bindings, compose rows and deep-copy
entries.costs: selection duplicates descriptors and prunes; names copies strings

entries.name: Element constructors/scalar_from_bytes
entries.purpose: Construct owned heterogeneous metadata with exact numerical dtype
entries.costs: private heap allocation; memcpy reads exact type; width retained separately

entries.name: Element view/copy/set/byte-order/erase/validate
entries.purpose: Mutate mapping and metadata and recursively validate
entries.costs: mapping is mutable shared state; key search linear; explicit byte-order contract

entries.name: ElementView typed accessors and mapping operations
entries.purpose: Inspect selected or owned metadata payloads
entries.costs: type checks and owner-versus-view branches; keys copied

entries.name: ElementView::copy
entries.purpose: Recursively deep-copy active value and scalar metadata
entries.costs: single switch retains dtype and byte order; mapping uses repeated linear insertion

entries.name: AnnData construction, X and table access/replacement
entries.purpose: Establish axes, optional matrix, aligned tables and direct column paths
entries.costs: default numbered names materialize; obs/var views snapshot; index rebinding iterates aligned tables

entries.name: AnnData aligned slot, edit, name, uns and raw operations
entries.purpose: Enforce alignment and access named arrays, tables, metadata and raw
entries.costs: direct index comparison; ordered-vector lookup linear; names allocate; raw is observation aligned

entries.name: AnnDataView constructors and AnnData::view
entries.purpose: Capture binding snapshot for retained view
entries.costs: copies name/binding lists, allocates aligned element wrappers and per-column descriptors

entries.name: AnnDataView getters and raw getters
entries.purpose: Read selected retained slot bindings and metadata
entries.costs: linear slot lookup; copied key lists; shared retained payloads

entries.name: AnnDataView::slice including aligned slots, category colors and raw
entries.purpose: Compose absolute axes and preserve AnnData categorical-color/raw semantics
entries.costs: allocates maps and wrappers, scans categories; scalar promotion and pruning preserve upstream behavior

entries.name: AnnDataView::copy and AnnData::validate
entries.purpose: Materialize all selected bindings and verify shape/index/nested content
entries.costs: recursive copies and validation; no internal synchronization; caller controls concurrent accesses
